title: DOE says addressing 'emerging risks' as major shipping line bans EV, hybrid onboard vessels
summary: The DOE said it is addressing concerns linked to electric and hybrid vehicles after a major shipping line banned these types of vehicles from boarding its vessels as a "safety precaution."
